host.title: Server resources (host-wide)
host.description: Workspace server measurements, independent of the person and source filters. Load and system memory are the whole host’s as the app sees it, other tenants included; this deployment’s own use is under Deployment services. Collected every {{seconds}} seconds; storage totals are collected daily. No history is inferred before collection starts.
host.no-gaps: Every resource metric has recent history.

deployment.title: Deployment services
deployment.description: Every running container of this deployment: its stacks, plugin services and socios’ computers, read through the read-only disk usage proxy with each resource sample. These are this deployment’s own numbers, apart from the host-wide ones below, which include other tenants on a shared host. CPU is a percent of one CPU. Restarts count the replaced tasks the orchestrator still keeps (updates included).

state.off: Deployment metrics are unavailable: they need the read-only disk usage proxy (COMPUTER_DISK_USAGE_URL).
state.pending: Deployment metrics are not measured yet. They are read with each resource sample.
state.unavailable: Deployment metrics are unavailable: the last read through the disk usage proxy failed or is out of date.

deployment.shown-below: The last numbers collected are shown below.
deployment.limits-meter: Memory in use by limited services, of their limits
deployment.no-limits: No service has a memory limit.
deployment.limits-share: {{share}}% of the sum of limits, by the services that have one.
deployment.cpu-meter: Deployment CPU, of the node's CPUs
deployment.node-cpus_one: {{share}}% of the node’s {{count, number}} CPU. CPU limits aren’t readable here.
deployment.node-cpus_other: {{share}}% of the node’s {{count, number}} CPUs. CPU limits aren’t readable here.
deployment.node-meter: Deployment memory, of the node's memory
deployment.node-shared: The node’s memory, shared with other tenants.
deployment.no-limit-badge: No limit: can starve its neighbors

computers.title: Socio computers
computers.description: Current resource readings and hourly history for computers with permissions or retained history. Disk includes workspace, private homes and browser profile volumes. App OOM counts cover retained attempts in the selected period. Socio and Space filters apply; shared computers are independent of the person and source filters.
computers.disk-off: Disk usage is not set up: it needs the read-only disk usage proxy (COMPUTER_DISK_USAGE_URL).
computers.disk-unavailable_one: Disk usage is unavailable: the last measurement through Docker failed. It is tried again every {{count, number}} minute.
computers.disk-unavailable_other: Disk usage is unavailable: the last measurement through Docker failed. It is tried again every {{count, number}} minutes.
computers.disk-measured_one: Disk usage is measured through Docker every {{count, number}} minute.
computers.disk-measured_other: Disk usage is measured through Docker every {{count, number}} minutes.
computers.more: Showing the first 100 computers. Narrow the socio or Space filter for more.
computers.empty: No computers with permissions or retained resource history in this view.
